title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (React / Next.js + Python / FastAPI)
description:
We’re looking for a strong Lead Full-Stack Developer to join our team.

Requirements:

  • Strong experience with React / Next.js
  • Strong Python / FastAPI backend experience
  • Experience leading technical decisions and code reviews
  • Solid understanding of scalable production systems
  • FinTech experience is required
  • Experience with trading, brokerage, payments, banking, or other financial products is a strong plus
    Please note that completing a test assignment is a mandatory part of the hiring process.
  • If you’ve read this far, please start your cover letter with the word “apple.”
